svg.aria-label: The businesses. Dahhan Enterprises, with roots since 1990, is the international corporate identity connecting three businesses: Dahhan Industries, since 1990: fabrics, lace, elastics and textile accessories; Miss Dantella, since 2000: women's lingerie, underwear and nightwear; M1D0 Technologies, founded in 2025: business and digital transformation. Dahhan Industries supplies the fabrics, lace, elastics and accessories in Miss Dantella's collections. M1D0 leads the transformation and long-term development of Dahhan Industries and Miss Dantella.
